en: The Pair of States to be Abandoned by Seeing, and the Triplet of the Wholesome.

Dependent on a wholesome state eradicated by vision (*dassanena pahātabba*), an unwholesome state not eradicated by vision arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*). [Under] root [condition], one; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance, one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state eradicated by vision, a state that is neither unwholesome nor eradicated by vision arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome state not eradicated by vision, [a state not eradicated by vision arises...]

A state that is not unwholesome and is to be abandoned by seeing arises conditioned by a state that is to be abandoned by seeing and is unwholesome, through the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under the root-condition there are two; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are two.

Conditioned by a state that is indeterminate and is not to be abandoned by seeing, a state that is neither to be abandoned by seeing nor indeterminate arises through the root-condition. ... Under the root-condition there are two; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are two.
